justification: A step limit is only an obstacle when it falls below what the level needs. The atrium's shortest winning sequence is eighteen commands -- up to the button, back down, across to the door, down through the teleport, up the right room and onto the goal -- and the budget here is 60. The wrapper therefore removes nothing: every winning sequence of the base game is still a winning sequence.
notes: The near-twin of the budgeted unsolvable item on the same board. The operator is identical in kind; only the arithmetic differs.
